items.title: Mrs. Robert George (Mary) Hoffman Interview, 1976-02-05
items.q: I frequented the store when I played the piano in the store... Carl worked for the, the uncle. So, he went up in this elevator at the same time I did.

ctx.x: I know the name again. Geringer, all right.

Well, so, I got up nerve enough, as inexperienced as I was and everything, to go there to ask him, uh, to tell him that I heard that the lady who played there had quit the night before and that, uh, I would like to get the job. And as I walked up, no, went up in a little elevator that ran up, you know who Carl Goldenberg is? Carl Goldenberg, he later was either the owner or the manager of one of the big bakeries here.
I don't know that name at all.
